identity_evidence.quote: A patient with a past medical history of hypertension (HTN)

attribution_limitations: The sentence states that hemoglobin remained stable and that deep venous thrombosis prophylaxis was initiated on HD 5; whether 'on HD 5' also times the stable hemoglobin is not clear, so the stable hemoglobin carries no day.
The chest tube insertion sentence does not state the side; only the removal sentence names a left chest tube. Insertion laterality is left unset.
The source and Fig. 1 caption describe the STEMI as in the inferolateral leads, while the culprit lesion is a proximal LAD thrombus with an anteroapical wall motion abnormality. Recorded as printed.
The hemoglobin of 7.8 g/dL after the second transfusion, the transfusion itself and the SBP in the 90s that led to stopping Cardene have no stated hospital day.
